title: OfficeTown: Generative Organizations for Evolving Agent Intelligence
title_zh: OfficeTown：面向演化型智能体智能的生成式组织框架

paragraphs.en: AI agents increasingly use files and software tools to produce professional deliverables. Such work draws on materials, decisions, and feedback accumulated across assignments. We introduce OfficeTown, a generative simulation framework for professional organizations in which tasks and their context arise from continuing organizational work. From a natural-language description of an organization’s purpose and activities, OfficeTown initializes an organization whose members coordinate work, delegate bounded assignments to assistant agents, and review their deliverables. Artifacts, decisions, and unresolved matters persist and shape subsequent work, while responsibilities and permissions determine what each member can see and do. We curate work requests, their context, and review feedback into executable resources for evaluation and learning. We construct OfficeTown Bench with 406 tasks and 4,836 evaluation criteria from 23 simulated organizations across eight professional domains, incorporating domain-expert feedback. Frontier-model evaluations reveal substantial remaining headroom. Supervised fine-tuning and on-policy distillation on OfficeTown data substantially improve Qwen3.5-9B on external professional-work benchmarks, including GDPval. Supplementary evaluations show that the principal–assistant harness achieves higher scores than the single- and multi-agent baselines tested. These results highlight the value of organizational simulation in generating work-grounded data and environments for the continued development of generalist agents.
paragraphs.zh: AI 智能体越来越多地使用文件和软件工具来产出专业的交付成果。 这类工作依赖于在各任务中积累的材料、决策和反馈。 我们提出 OfficeTown，一个面向专业组织的生成式模拟框架，其中任务及其上下文源自持续进行的组织工作。 OfficeTown 根据对组织宗旨和活动的自然语言描述，初始化一个组织，其成员协调工作、将有界的任务委派给助手智能体，并审查它们的交付成果。 产物、决策和未决事项持续存在并影响后续工作，而职责和权限决定每个成员可以看到和做什么。 我们将工作请求、其上下文以及评审反馈整理为可用于评估和学习的可执行资源。 我们构建了 OfficeTown Bench，其中包含来自八个专业领域、23 个模拟组织的 406 个任务和 4,836 条评估标准，并融入了领域专家的反馈。 对前沿模型的评估显示仍有很大的提升空间。 在 OfficeTown 数据上进行监督微调和策略内蒸馏，显著提升了 Qwen3.5-9B 在外部专业工作基准（包括 GDPval）上的表现。 补充评估表明，主管–助手架构比所测试的单智能体和多智能体基线获得了更高的分数。 这些结果凸显了组织模拟在生成基于工作的数据和环境、以推动通用智能体持续发展方面的价值。

paragraphs.en: Large language models are increasingly expected to produce professional deliverables using files, software tools, and organizational knowledge. Recent benchmarks ( Patwardhan et al., 2025 ) and environment-synthesis methods ( Dong et al., 2026 ) provide valuable resources for evaluating these capabilities, but typically treat tasks as isolated instances. Real professional work is rarely isolated. In organizations, assignments arise from ongoing activity rather than appearing independently. Deliverables are reviewed and revised, decisions create follow-up requests, and materials accumulated in one project become inputs to later work. Tasks therefore emerge from a continuing process in which work products and work context co-evolve.
paragraphs.zh: 人们越来越期望大型语言模型能够利用文件、软件工具和组织知识来产出专业交付成果。 最近的基准测试（Patwardhan 等，2025）和环境合成方法（Dong 等，2026）为评估这些能力提供了宝贵资源，但它们通常将任务视为孤立的实例。 真实的专业工作很少是孤立进行的。 在组织中，任务分配源自持续进行的活动，而不是独立出现。 交付成果会被审查和修改，决策会引发后续请求，而在一个项目中积累的材料会成为后续工作的输入。 因此，任务产生于一个工作产品与工作情境共同演化的持续过程之中。

paragraphs.en: This observation suggests a different perspective. Instead of generating standalone tasks, we may seek to model the system that continuously produces professional work. Such a system would naturally generate new assignments, contextual materials, review feedback, and long-range dependencies, offering a scalable source of both evaluation and training data.

paragraphs.en: Professional organizations are precisely such systems. We therefore introduce OfficeTown, a generative simulation framework for professional organizations. From a natural-language description of an organization’s purpose and activities, OfficeTown constructs persistent organizational structures, roles, resources, and authority boundaries, then simulates ongoing work as professionals coordinate, delegate, review, and follow up on assignments. Organizational state is persistent but not globally observable: each member has a permission-filtered view determined by role, ownership, and sharing rules, and acts within their role-specific authority. Figure 1 illustrates a Juniper instance.
paragraphs.zh: 专业组织正是这样的系统。 因此，我们提出 OfficeTown，一个面向专业组织的生成式仿真框架。 只需以自然语言描述一个组织的目标与活动，OfficeTown 即可构建持久存在的组织结构、角色、资源与权限边界，并模拟专业人员协调、委派、审查和跟进任务的持续工作过程。 组织状态是持久的，但并非全局可观测：每个成员拥有一个由角色、所有权和共享规则决定的经权限过滤的视图，并在其角色特定的权限范围内行动。 图 1 展示了一个 Juniper 实例。

paragraphs.en: Organizational state includes personal working files, shared materials, communications, commitments, and pending decisions. Each professional maintains a persistent workspace (Figure 2 e) and structured work records separate from active conversation context, so refreshing a model session does not erase unresolved work. Each activation presents selected work records alongside current requests, prioritizing outstanding commitments and discussions awaiting a response.
paragraphs.zh: 组织状态包括个人工作文件、共享资料、沟通记录、承诺事项以及待决事项。 每位专业人员都拥有一个持久化工作区（图2 e）以及独立于当前对话上下文的结构化工作记录，因此刷新模型会话不会抹除未完成的工作。 每次激活时都会在呈现当前请求的同时展示精选的工作记录，并优先突出未完成的承诺和等待回复的讨论。

sents.zh: 组织状态包括个人工作文件、共享资料、沟通记录、承诺事项以及待决事项。

paragraphs.en: This state is persistent but not globally observable. Role permissions, ownership, sharing rules, and confidentiality determine each member’s information view; role-specific authority determines what they may do with it. Reporting relationships do not automatically grant file access. Assistants receive writable working files and permission-filtered, read-only shared references within the principal’s authorization, not access to other professionals’ private workspaces.
paragraphs.zh: 该状态是持久化的，但并非全局可观察。 角色权限、所有权、共享规则和保密性决定每个成员的信息视图；角色专属权限决定他们可以对这些信息做什么。 汇报关系不会自动授予文件访问权限。 智能体在委托人的授权范围内接收可写的工作文件和经过权限过滤的只读共享参考资料，而不是访问其他专业人士的私有工作区。

sents.zh: 该状态是持久化的，但并非全局可观察。

paragraphs.en: Saving, accepting, and sharing a deliverable are distinct actions. Saving retains files, including drafts and pending revisions; professional review determines acceptance; explicit sharing makes an accepted deliverable available to authorized recipients. Thus, saved work need not be accepted or visible to others. Acceptance, version, classification, and recipient permissions are checked before broader publication. Appendices A.4 – A.6 cover workspace checks, sessions, and recovery.
paragraphs.zh: 保存、接受和共享交付物是三种不同的操作。 保存会保留文件，包括草稿和待定修订；专业评审决定是否接受；显式共享使已接受的交付物可供授权接收者获取。 因此，已保存的工作不一定被接受，也不一定对他人可见。 在更广泛发布之前，会检查接受状态、版本、分类和接收者权限。 附录 A.4–A.6 涵盖工作区检查、会话和恢复。

sents.zh: 附录 A.4–A.6 涵盖工作区检查、会话和恢复。

paragraphs.en: Work follows a shared simulated calendar, with professionals activated asynchronously by incoming requests, messages, meetings, follow-ups, or assistant deliveries (Figure 2 b). The simulation controls activation and permitted actions; the professional’s model decides how to respond using current requests, commitments, and accessible materials. Several matters can therefore progress concurrently. Appendix A.6 details scheduling and clock control.
paragraphs.zh: 工作遵循一个共享的模拟日历，专业人员由传入的请求、消息、会议、后续事项或助手交付物异步激活（图 2 b）。 模拟控制激活和允许执行的操作；专业人员的模型则根据当前的请求、承诺和可访问的材料来决定如何回应。 因此，多项事务可以并发推进。 附录 A.6 详细说明了调度与时钟控制。

sents.en: Work follows a shared simulated calendar, with professionals activated asynchronously by incoming requests, messages, meetings, follow-ups, or assistant deliveries (Figure 2 b).
sents.zh: 工作遵循一个共享的模拟日历，专业人员由传入的请求、消息、会议、后续事项或助手交付物异步激活（图 2 b）。

sents.zh: 因此，多项事务可以并发推进。

sents.en: Appendix A.6 details scheduling and clock control.
sents.zh: 附录 A.6 详细说明了调度与时钟控制。

paragraphs.en: When responsibilities intersect, members exchange permitted materials, question assumptions, and seek colleagues’ input. Team leads can meet to clarify objectives, identify missing inputs, and allocate responsibilities; meetings are not required for every assignment. Agreed work is recorded as requests specifying the intended outcome, responsible person, supporting materials, and deadline. Appendix A.3 provides a recorded example.
paragraphs.zh: 当职责出现交叉时，成员们会交换被允许使用的资料、质疑假设并征求同事的意见。 团队负责人可以开会以澄清目标、识别缺失的输入并分配职责；并非每项任务都需要开会。 商定的工作以请求的形式记录，其中注明预期成果、负责人、支持材料和截止日期。 附录 A.3 提供了一个有记录的示例。

sents.zh: 当职责出现交叉时，成员们会交换被允许使用的资料、质疑假设并征求同事的意见。

paragraphs.en: For delegated execution, the principal specifies the objective, available inputs, constraints, and expected deliverable. The assistant works within the authorized workspace and can ask the principal to clarify requirements or consult colleagues. On delivery, the principal inspects the actual artifact and decides whether to accept it, request revisions, or seek further information. Review can change both deliverable requirements and the work that other members need to undertake. These reviews are organizational decisions within the simulated organization, not independent benchmark judgments.
paragraphs.zh: 在委托执行中，委托人指定目标、可用输入、约束条件以及预期交付物。 助手在授权的工作区内工作，可以要求委托人澄清需求或咨询同事。 在交付时，委托人检查实际的成果物，并决定是接受它、要求修改，还是获取更多信息。 审查可以同时改变交付物需求和其他成员需要承担的工作。 这些审查是模拟组织内部的组织决策，而不是独立的基准判断。

sents.zh: 在委托执行中，委托人指定目标、可用输入、约束条件以及预期交付物。

paragraphs.en: Revisions build on submitted artifacts and review comments. Accepted results can become inputs to authorized colleagues’ work, while unresolved questions remain available for later investigation. These updates link assignments through accumulated context, extending work beyond the initial seed. Appendix A.7 illustrates material accumulation over six simulated months.
paragraphs.zh: 修订基于已提交的产物和评审意见。 已采纳的结果可以成为被授权同事工作的输入，而未解决的问题仍可留待后续研究。 这些更新通过积累的上下文将各任务关联起来，使工作超越最初的种子而不断延展。 附录 A.7 展示了六个模拟月份内的材料积累情况。

sents.zh: 修订基于已提交的产物和评审意见。

sents.zh: 已采纳的结果可以成为被授权同事工作的输入，而未解决的问题仍可留待后续研究。

paragraphs.en: An executable task pairs a work request with materials available to its responsible professional when the work was assigned (Figure 2 c). This task-time snapshot preserves both temporal and permission boundaries: personal files, authorized shared resources, and existing artifacts needed for revision may be included, but later solutions and evaluator-only information are excluded.
paragraphs.zh: 一个可执行的任务将工作请求与该负责专业人员在任务被分配时可用的材料配对（图 2 c）。 这种任务-时间快照同时保留了时间边界和权限边界：可以包含个人文件、经授权的共享资源以及修订所需的既有成果，但不包含后来的解决方案和仅供评估者使用的信息。

sents.en: An executable task pairs a work request with materials available to its responsible professional when the work was assigned (Figure 2 c).
sents.zh: 一个可执行的任务将工作请求与该负责专业人员在任务被分配时可用的材料配对（图 2 c）。

sents.en: This task-time snapshot preserves both temporal and permission boundaries: personal files, authorized shared resources, and existing artifacts needed for revision may be included, but later solutions and evaluator-only information are excluded.
sents.zh: 这种任务-时间快照同时保留了时间边界和权限边界：可以包含个人文件、经授权的共享资源以及修订所需的既有成果，但不包含后来的解决方案和仅供评估者使用的信息。

paragraphs.en: Each attempt starts in a fresh workspace initialized from these fixed inputs, where the agent can inspect and edit files, execute commands, and use the provided interfaces. The continuing organization is the source of the assignment; individual evaluation or learning attempts do not require replaying its entire history. Section 3 explains selection, expert-informed refinement, and packaging into benchmark and training resources.
paragraphs.zh: 每次尝试都在一个由这些固定输入初始化的全新工作区中开始，智能体可以在其中检查和编辑文件、执行命令，并使用所提供的接口。 持续运作的组织是任务分配的来源；单次评估或学习尝试无需回放其全部历史。 第 3 节介绍筛选、由专家参与的细化，以及打包成基准测试和训练资源的过程。

sents.en: Section 3 explains selection, expert-informed refinement, and packaging into benchmark and training resources.
sents.zh: 第 3 节介绍筛选、由专家参与的细化，以及打包成基准测试和训练资源的过程。

paragraphs.en: We curate assignments and their task-time environments from ongoing organizational work into OfficeTown Bench and training resources. The benchmark measures professional task completion, while execution demonstrations and interactive task environments support learning.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将持续的组织工作中的任务分配及其任务时间环境整理进 OfficeTown Bench 与培训资源中。 该基准测试衡量专业任务的完成情况，同时执行演示与交互式任务环境则支持学习。

sents.en: We curate assignments and their task-time environments from ongoing organizational work into OfficeTown Bench and training resources.
sents.zh: 我们将持续的组织工作中的任务分配及其任务时间环境整理进 OfficeTown Bench 与培训资源中。

paragraphs.en: OfficeTown Bench covers eight professional domains selected for economic relevance and digital executability, inspired by GDPval ( Patwardhan et al., 2025 ) . It contains 406 tasks and 4,836 evaluation criteria from 23 simulated organizations, involving delegating professionals with 139 distinct job titles. The benchmark includes 247 file-based tasks and 159 tasks involving service state. Figure 4 and Table 4 report its domain coverage and input-material composition.
paragraphs.zh: OfficeTown Bench 受 GDPval（Patwardhan et al., 2025）启发，涵盖八个因经济相关性和数字可执行性而被选中的专业领域。 它包含来自 23 个模拟组织的 406 个任务和 4,836 条评估标准，涉及委派给拥有 139 种不同职头的专业人士。 该基准测试包含 247 个基于文件的任务和 159 个涉及服务状态的任务。 图 4 和表 4 报告了其领域覆盖范围和输入材料构成。

sents.en: OfficeTown Bench covers eight professional domains selected for economic relevance and digital executability, inspired by GDPval ( Patwardhan et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: OfficeTown Bench 受 GDPval（Patwardhan et al., 2025）启发，涵盖八个因经济相关性和数字可执行性而被选中的专业领域。

sents.zh: 该基准测试包含 247 个基于文件的任务和 159 个涉及服务状态的任务。

sents.en: Figure 4 and Table 4 report its domain coverage and input-material composition.
sents.zh: 图 4 和表 4 报告了其领域覆盖范围和输入材料构成。

paragraphs.en: Each sample combines a work request, an executable environment, and a task-specific rubric. Environments supply the files, tools, and authorized organizational state for the assignment; rubrics assess professional requirements but remain outside the agent’s starting context.
paragraphs.zh: 每个样本由一个工作请求、一个可执行环境和一个针对任务的评分标准组成。 环境为任务提供文件、工具和经授权的组织状态；评分标准评估专业要求，但不包含在智能体的初始上下文中。

sents.en: Each sample combines a work request, an executable environment, and a task-specific rubric.
sents.zh: 每个样本由一个工作请求、一个可执行环境和一个针对任务的评分标准组成。

sents.en: Environments supply the files, tools, and authorized organizational state for the assignment; rubrics assess professional requirements but remain outside the agent’s starting context.
sents.zh: 环境为任务提供文件、工具和经授权的组织状态；评分标准评估专业要求，但不包含在智能体的初始上下文中。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 illustrates a mechanical-design assignment. Given workpiece geometry, feature tables, design assumptions, and engineering references, the agent must compare two locating-and-clamping approaches in an editable workbook with reproducible calculation code. The rubric assesses mechanical plausibility, sensitivity to uncertain inputs, and agreement between the workbook and code.
paragraphs.zh: 图4展示了一个机械设计任务。 在给定工件几何形状、特征表、设计假设和工程参考资料的情况下，智能体必须在一个可编辑的工作簿中以可复现的计算代码比较两种定位夹紧方案。 评分标准评估机械合理性、对不确定输入的敏感性，以及工作簿与代码之间的一致性。

sents.en: Figure 4 illustrates a mechanical-design assignment.
sents.zh: 图4展示了一个机械设计任务。

sents.en: Given workpiece geometry, feature tables, design assumptions, and engineering references, the agent must compare two locating-and-clamping approaches in an editable workbook with reproducible calculation code.
sents.zh: 在给定工件几何形状、特征表、设计假设和工程参考资料的情况下，智能体必须在一个可编辑的工作簿中以可复现的计算代码比较两种定位夹紧方案。

sents.zh: 评分标准评估机械合理性、对不确定输入的敏感性，以及工作簿与代码之间的一致性。

paragraphs.en: We inspect delegated requests and their working materials, then edit them into self-contained evaluation tasks while retaining work objectives, constraints, and intended deliverables. Task environments preserve the relevant starting materials, including artifacts requiring revision, but exclude historical solutions to the evaluated task and evaluator-only information.
paragraphs.zh: 我们检查委托的请求及其工作材料，然后将它们编辑成自成一体的评估任务，同时保留工作目标、约束条件和预期的交付成果。 任务环境保留相关的起始材料，包括需要修改的制品，但不包含被评估任务的历史解决方案以及仅供评估者使用的信息。

sents.en: We inspect delegated requests and their working materials, then edit them into self-contained evaluation tasks while retaining work objectives, constraints, and intended deliverables.
sents.zh: 我们检查委托的请求及其工作材料，然后将它们编辑成自成一体的评估任务，同时保留工作目标、约束条件和预期的交付成果。

sents.en: Task environments preserve the relevant starting materials, including artifacts requiring revision, but exclude historical solutions to the evaluated task and evaluator-only information.
sents.zh: 任务环境保留相关的起始材料，包括需要修改的制品，但不包含被评估任务的历史解决方案以及仅供评估者使用的信息。

paragraphs.en: Rubrics are drafted by a language model from task requirements and inspected source materials. paragraphs.en: During benchmark construction, 71 domain experts contributed feedback on task realism, clarity, input sufficiency, and feasibility, as well as rubric correctness, coverage, and alignment. paragraphs.en: GPT-6 Astra leads with 74.4% Pass@1, followed by Grok-4.7 at 58.4% and Claude Opus 5.5 at 50.7%. Even Astra leaves roughly one quarter of tasks incompletely delivered. paragraphs.en: This supplementary study tests whether the principal–assistant design for delegation, clarification, and review is useful beyond the simulated organizations. We compare OfficeTown Harness with Codex, MetaGPT ( Hong et al., 2024 ) , and CAMEL ( Li et al., 2023 ) using GPT-5.5 xhigh throughout on external tasks (Table 4 ). OfficeTown has the highest reported point estimate in all five columns, covering initial development and feedback-guided revision (PRDBench DEV/DEBUG; Fu et al., 2026 ), business rules (GDPevo; Zhou et al., 2026 ), terminal work ( Merrill et al., 2026 ) , and research code ( Hua et al., 2025 ) . paragraphs.en: OfficeTown connects organizational simulation with executable environment generation. Earlier artifacts, decisions, and unresolved matters shape subsequent work, while roles, ownership, and sharing rules scope the information and authority available for each assignment. This persistent, permissioned process generates tasks, context, and feedback for evaluation and training.
paragraphs.zh: OfficeTown 将组织仿真与可执行环境生成相结合。 早期的产物、决策和未决事项会影响后续工作，而角色、所有权和共享规则则为每项任务界定了可用的信息与权限。 这一持久化的、带有权限控制的过程会生成用于评估和训练的任务、上下文与反馈。

paragraphs.en: OfficeTown models professional organizations as persistent, permissioned, and evolving work systems. Tasks, contextual materials, and feedback arise from ongoing work, rather than being constructed as isolated instances. Benchmark evaluations reveal a gap between partial fulfillment and complete professional delivery, while training results demonstrate the learning value of the generated work on external benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: OfficeTown 将专业组织建模为持久的、有权限的且不断演进的工作系统。 任务、情境材料与反馈都源自持续进行的工作，而不是被构造为孤立的实例。 基准评测揭示了部分完成与完整专业交付之间的差距，而训练结果则证明了所生成工作在外部基准上的学习价值。

paragraphs.en: Looking ahead, we will extend these simulations to more professional domains and institutional settings, with richer interactions, longer-running workflows, and collaboration across organizations. We will also investigate how persistent history, scoped access, and review shape task generation and learning outcomes. Improving simulation fidelity and efficiency, and validating simulated work against real professional practice, will be important as these systems expand.
paragraphs.zh: 展望未来，我们将把这些模拟扩展到更多专业领域和机构场景中，带来更丰富的交互、更长周期的任务流，以及跨组织的协作。 我们还将研究持久化的历史记录、范围受限的访问权限以及审查机制如何影响任务生成与学习成果。 随着这些系统的扩展，提升模拟的保真度与效率，并将模拟工作与现实中的专业实践进行对照验证，将变得十分重要。

paragraphs.en: OfficeTown uses referenced public sources, adapted materials, and synthetic records; it does not use private customer records. Domain experts contributed feedback on tasks and rubrics, and we report their contributions in aggregate. Occupational taxonomies and generative models can encode social and professional biases, so simulated organizations are examples rather than authoritative representations of occupations, institutions, or demographic groups. Tool-using agents can create privacy, security, and operational risks. In OfficeTown, agents operate within permission-scoped workspaces and synthetic authority; they are not used for real-world financial, legal, clinical, employment, or external-release decisions. Releases should preserve source attribution and licensing, remove sensitive operational information, and document intended use and limitations. OfficeTown is the name of this research project, not a Microsoft Office product.
paragraphs.zh: OfficeTown 使用引用的公开来源、改编材料以及合成记录；不使用私人客户记录。 领域专家为任务和评分标准提供了反馈，我们以汇总方式报告他们的贡献。 职业分类体系和生成式模型可能编码社会和职业偏见，因此模拟组织只是示例，而非对职业、机构或人口群体的权威呈现。 使用工具的智能体可能带来隐私、安全和运营风险。 在 OfficeTown 中，智能体在权限受限的工作区和合成授权范围内运行；它们不用于现实世界的财务、法律、临床、雇佣或对外发布决策。 发布时应保留来源署名和许可信息，移除敏感的运营信息，并说明预期用途和局限性。 OfficeTown 是本研究的项目名称，并非 Microsoft Office 产品。

paragraphs.en: A construction request combines a description of the organization’s purpose and activities (as short as one sentence) with optional settings for organization size, language, and simulation period. paragraphs.en: To build the seed, OfficeTown uses Web search to locate relevant professional guidance, reference documents, datasets, and worked examples. Retrieved materials are either retained in their original form or adapted to the organization’s work. Synthetic records supply the organization-specific information needed to begin work, such as customer operating data, opening balances, and current business questions.
paragraphs.zh: 为了构建种子，OfficeTown 使用网络搜索来查找相关的专业指导、参考文档、数据集和实例演示。 检索到的材料要么以原始形式保留，要么根据组织的工作需要进行改编。 合成记录提供了开始工作所需的组织特定信息，例如客户运营数据、期初余额和当前的业务问题。

paragraphs.en: OfficeTown connects professionals to running office services through service-backed tools: Rocket.Chat for direct messages and team channels, Mailpit for email, and Baïkal for calendars and meeting scheduling. Deliveries are also recorded in persistent, recipient-specific inboxes, which the simulation uses to present incoming work. A recipient receives the message and permitted references, not the sender’s private working context.
paragraphs.zh: OfficeTown 通过服务支撑的工具将专业人士与正在运行的办公服务连接起来：Rocket.Chat 用于直接消息和团队频道，Mailpit 用于电子邮件，Baïkal 用于日历和会议安排。 投递内容还会被记录到持久的、面向特定接收者的收件箱中，模拟环境利用这些收件箱来呈现传入的工作。 接收者收到的是消息及其被允许的引用内容，而不是发送者的私人工作上下文。

paragraphs.en: Work records are stored independently of active conversation context. They retain commitments, ongoing discussions, unresolved decisions, and recent interactions with colleagues (Figure 9 (b)). Commitments record what is owed and to whom; discussions identify who should respond next. Communication and work actions update these records through explicit requests and rule-based message cues. Clearing an incoming reminder does not mark the promised deliverable as complete. These structured records are distinct from the additional semantic-memory backend, which is disabled in the Juniper configuration (Table 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 工作记录与活跃的对话上下文分开存储。 它们保留承诺、进行中的讨论、未决事项以及与同事的近期互动（图 9 (b)）。 承诺记录欠什么以及欠谁；讨论标明下一个应由谁回应。 通信和工作行为通过显式请求和基于规则的消息线索来更新这些记录。 清除一条传入提醒并不会将承诺的交付物标记为已完成。 这些结构化记录不同于附加的语义记忆后端，后者在 Juniper 配置中被禁用（表 5）。

paragraphs.en: Only selected records enter each turn. Outstanding promises take priority over routine reminders, and discussions awaiting the professional’s reply take priority over other exchanges. The default limits are eight active commitments, five discussions, five unresolved decisions, and ten colleague records. Professionals can also maintain personal notes containing working assumptions, document references, and follow-up plans. Recent notes are included within a separate size budget, while current project and request states are read from the simulation’s stored records.
paragraphs.zh: 每轮仅选定的记录会进入对话。 未兑现的承诺优先于常规提醒，等待专业人士回复的讨论优先于其他交流。 默认上限为八项活跃承诺、五场讨论、五项未决决定和十条同事记录。 专业人士还可以维护包含工作假设、文档引用和后续计划的个人笔记。 最近的笔记在单独的大小预算内纳入，而当前项目和请求状态则从模拟的存储记录中读取。

paragraphs.en: OfficeTown also supports an optional persistent-session mode for continuing coordination. The main session retains available conversation context alongside current requests and project state. Detailed inspections take place in a branch of the same professional’s session (Figure 9 (a)). The branch inherits the current context and supports file inspection and tool use. In the illustrative forecast review, the professional identifies missing source links and requests a revision. A concise record of the conclusion, actions, and tools used returns to the main session, without retaining the full inspection in its active context.
paragraphs.zh: OfficeTown 还支持可选的持久会话模式，用于继续协调。 主会话在保留当前请求和项目状态的同时，还保留了可用的对话上下文。 详细检查在同一专业人士会话的分支中进行（图 9 (a)）。 该分支继承当前上下文，并支持文件检查和工具使用。 在示例性的预测审查中，该专业人士发现缺少来源链接，并请求进行修订。 结论、所采取的操作和所用工具的简要记录会返回主会话，而完整的检查内容不会保留在其活动上下文中。

paragraphs.en: At simulated day boundaries in this mode, the main context is refreshed by reopening the session under the same identifier with saved work records and current office state. The pending forecast revision in the illustration can therefore inform a later turn without preserving the full earlier conversation. OfficeTown also supports optional compaction, which summarizes earlier exchanges while retaining recent messages (Figure 9 (c)). Its periodic trigger is disabled by default.
paragraphs.zh: 在此模式下，在模拟的日界处，主上下文会通过在同一标识符下重新打开会话并载入已保存的工作记录和当前办公状态来刷新。 因此，图中待处理的预测修订可以在后续轮次中发挥作用，而无需保留之前完整的对话。 OfficeTown 还支持可选的压缩功能，即对较早的交互进行摘要，同时保留最近的消息（图 9 (c)）。 其周期性触发默认处于禁用状态。

paragraphs.en: In direct-home mode, the runtime provides a writable copy of the principal’s current home at /home/npc/computer , together with authorized shared references. A runtime-generated instruction block identifies the principal and distinguishes writable files, read-only inputs, and temporary scratch space. Tasks requiring narrower access instead receive an isolated view with selected inputs and designated working and submission directories. Committed work remains in the professional’s persistent workspace after the execution container is released.
paragraphs.zh: 在直接主目录模式下，运行时在 /home/npc/computer 提供主体当前主目录的可写副本，并附带经授权的共享引用。 由运行时生成的指令块标识主体，并区分可写文件、只读输入和临时暂存空间。 需要更窄访问权限的任务则获得一个隔离视图，其中仅包含选定的输入以及指定的工作目录和提交目录。 在执行容器被释放后，已提交的工作仍保留在专业人员的持久化工作区中。

sents.en: In direct-home mode, the runtime provides a writable copy of the principal’s current home at /home/npc/computer , together with authorized shared references.
sents.zh: 在直接主目录模式下，运行时在 /home/npc/computer 提供主体当前主目录的可写副本，并附带经授权的共享引用。

sents.en: A runtime-generated instruction block identifies the principal and distinguishes writable files, read-only inputs, and temporary scratch space.
sents.zh: 由运行时生成的指令块标识主体，并区分可写文件、只读输入和临时暂存空间。

sents.en: Tasks requiring narrower access instead receive an isolated view with selected inputs and designated working and submission directories.
sents.zh: 需要更窄访问权限的任务则获得一个隔离视图，其中仅包含选定的输入以及指定的工作目录和提交目录。

sents.en: Committed work remains in the professional’s persistent workspace after the execution container is released.
sents.zh: 在执行容器被释放后，已提交的工作仍保留在专业人员的持久化工作区中。

paragraphs.en: Shared materials are presented through a separate, permission-filtered company view at /mnt/company . Ownership, role permissions, explicit sharing rules, and confidentiality classifications determine which documents appear in this view. A reporting relationship does not grant unrestricted access to another person’s files. Other professionals’ private homes are not mounted in the assistant’s environment. Shared documents are read-only: professionals and assistants can consult them or create their own working copies, but cannot directly overwrite the shared originals. File operations and terminal execution enforce these boundaries through path checks, read-only mounts, and sandboxing.
paragraphs.zh: 共享材料通过位于 /mnt/company 的独立、经权限过滤的公司视图呈现。 所有权、角色权限、明确的共享规则以及保密级别共同决定哪些文档会出现在该视图中。 汇报关系并不意味着可以不受限制地访问他人的文件。 其他专业人员的私人主目录不会挂载到智能体的环境中。 共享文档为只读：专业人员和智能体可以查阅它们或创建自己的工作副本，但不能直接覆盖共享原件。 文件操作和终端执行通过路径检查、只读挂载和沙箱机制来强制执行这些边界。

sents.en: Shared materials are presented through a separate, permission-filtered company view at /mnt/company .
sents.zh: 共享材料通过位于 /mnt/company 的独立、经权限过滤的公司视图呈现。

sents.en: Ownership, role permissions, explicit sharing rules, and confidentiality classifications determine which documents appear in this view.
sents.zh: 所有权、角色权限、明确的共享规则以及保密级别共同决定哪些文档会出现在该视图中。

sents.en: A reporting relationship does not grant unrestricted access to another person’s files.
sents.zh: 汇报关系并不意味着可以不受限制地访问他人的文件。

sents.en: Other professionals’ private homes are not mounted in the assistant’s environment.
sents.zh: 其他专业人员的私人主目录不会挂载到智能体的环境中。

sents.en: Shared documents are read-only: professionals and assistants can consult them or create their own working copies, but cannot directly overwrite the shared originals.
sents.zh: 共享文档为只读：专业人员和智能体可以查阅它们或创建自己的工作副本，但不能直接覆盖共享原件。

sents.en: File operations and terminal execution enforce these boundaries through path checks, read-only mounts, and sandboxing.
sents.zh: 文件操作和终端执行通过路径检查、只读挂载和沙箱机制来强制执行这些边界。

paragraphs.en: The revised workbook and new report in Figure 10 (b) enter the persistent workspace only after the runtime checks protected paths, file validity, and the underlying workspace revision. Writers to the same professional’s home are serialized to avoid conflicting updates. The runtime records the actual files created, modified, moved, or deleted, independently of the assistant’s completion report. The professional receives the deliverable locations, reported checks, and unresolved issues for review. Filesystem validation establishes what was saved; professional review determines whether the content meets the assignment’s requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 图 10 (b) 中的修订工作簿和新报告只有在运行时检查完受保护路径、文件有效性以及底层工作区版本后，才会进入持久化工作区。 对同一专业人士主目录的写入操作会被串行化，以避免相互冲突的更新。 运行时独立于智能体的完成报告，记录实际被创建、修改、移动或删除的文件。 专业人士会收到交付物的位置、已报告的检查以及未解决的问题，以供审阅。 文件系统验证确定保存了什么内容；专业人士审阅则判断内容是否满足任务的要求。

sents.en: The revised workbook and new report in Figure 10 (b) enter the persistent workspace only after the runtime checks protected paths, file validity, and the underlying workspace revision.
sents.zh: 图 10 (b) 中的修订工作簿和新报告只有在运行时检查完受保护路径、文件有效性以及底层工作区版本后，才会进入持久化工作区。

sents.en: Writers to the same professional’s home are serialized to avoid conflicting updates.
sents.zh: 对同一专业人士主目录的写入操作会被串行化，以避免相互冲突的更新。

sents.en: The runtime records the actual files created, modified, moved, or deleted, independently of the assistant’s completion report.
sents.zh: 运行时独立于智能体的完成报告，记录实际被创建、修改、移动或删除的文件。

sents.en: The professional receives the deliverable locations, reported checks, and unresolved issues for review.
sents.zh: 专业人士会收到交付物的位置、已报告的检查以及未解决的问题，以供审阅。

sents.en: Filesystem validation establishes what was saved; professional review determines whether the content meets the assignment’s requirements.
sents.zh: 文件系统验证确定保存了什么内容；专业人士审阅则判断内容是否满足任务的要求。

paragraphs.en: For broader publication, the professional selects an accepted deliverable and its intended audience. The runtime checks the acceptance record, file version, classification, and recipient permissions before making it available to authorized colleagues. Personal working materials can therefore accumulate without exposing every intermediate draft to the whole organization.
paragraphs.zh: 为了更广泛地发布，专业人员选择一个已验收的交付物及其目标受众。 运行时在将其提供给有权访问的同事之前，会检查验收记录、文件版本、分类以及接收者的权限。 因此，个人工作材料可以不断积累，而不会将每个中间草稿暴露给整个组织。

sents.en: For broader publication, the professional selects an accepted deliverable and its intended audience.
sents.zh: 为了更广泛地发布，专业人员选择一个已验收的交付物及其目标受众。

sents.en: The runtime checks the acceptance record, file version, classification, and recipient permissions before making it available to authorized colleagues.
sents.zh: 运行时在将其提供给有权访问的同事之前，会检查验收记录、文件版本、分类以及接收者的权限。

sents.en: Personal working materials can therefore accumulate without exposing every intermediate draft to the whole organization.
sents.zh: 因此，个人工作材料可以不断积累，而不会将每个中间草稿暴露给整个组织。

paragraphs.en: Simulated time is managed separately from wall-clock execution time. When adaptive pacing is enabled, OfficeTown slows or pauses the simulated clock as unfinished work accumulates, then resumes its advance as the backlog decreases. The clock is periodically saved together with the run’s original start and target times. A resumed run continues toward that target rather than beginning another full simulation period.
paragraphs.zh: 模拟时间与实际执行时间分开管理。 启用自适应调速后，当未完成的工作不断累积时，OfficeTown 会减慢或暂停模拟时钟，并在积压减少后恢复其推进。 时钟会连同运行的原始开始时间和目标时间一起定期保存。 恢复的运行会继续朝着该目标前进，而不是开始另一个完整的模拟周期。

sents.en: Simulated time is managed separately from wall-clock execution time.
sents.zh: 模拟时间与实际执行时间分开管理。

sents.en: When adaptive pacing is enabled, OfficeTown slows or pauses the simulated clock as unfinished work accumulates, then resumes its advance as the backlog decreases.
sents.zh: 启用自适应调速后，当未完成的工作不断累积时，OfficeTown 会减慢或暂停模拟时钟，并在积压减少后恢复其推进。

sents.en: The clock is periodically saved together with the run’s original start and target times.
sents.zh: 时钟会连同运行的原始开始时间和目标时间一起定期保存。

sents.en: A resumed run continues toward that target rather than beginning another full simulation period.
sents.zh: 恢复的运行会继续朝着该目标前进，而不是开始另一个完整的模拟周期。

paragraphs.en: Routine activations follow working hours and meeting schedules; designated interruptions can receive earlier attention. Professionals act asynchronously within limits on concurrent model calls and assistant workers. Work awaiting capacity remains pending.
paragraphs.zh: 例行激活遵循工作时间和会议日程；指定的中断可以更早得到处理。 专业人员在并发模型调用和助手工作进程的限制内异步执行操作。 等待容量的工作保持待处理状态。

sents.en: Routine activations follow working hours and meeting schedules; designated interruptions can receive earlier attention.
sents.zh: 例行激活遵循工作时间和会议日程；指定的中断可以更早得到处理。

sents.en: Professionals act asynchronously within limits on concurrent model calls and assistant workers.
sents.zh: 专业人员在并发模型调用和助手工作进程的限制内异步执行操作。

sents.en: Work awaiting capacity remains pending.
sents.zh: 等待容量的工作保持待处理状态。

paragraphs.en: Incoming messages remain in persistent inbox files, with acknowledgments tied to the exact source rows processed. Reading or queuing a message does not acknowledge it as processed. A partially processed batch retains acknowledgments even when rows finish out of order, leaving unprocessed rows available for later delivery. Capacity-deferred delegations retain their original identities and arguments when reconsidered for execution.
paragraphs.zh: 传入的消息保留在持久化的收件箱文件中，确认信息与所处理的确切源数据行绑定。 读取或排队一条消息并不意味着将其确认为已处理。 部分处理的批次仍会保留确认信息，即使各行处理顺序不同，未处理的行仍可供后续投递使用。 因容量不足而延迟的委派在重新考虑执行时，会保留其原始标识和参数。

sents.en: Incoming messages remain in persistent inbox files, with acknowledgments tied to the exact source rows processed.
sents.zh: 传入的消息保留在持久化的收件箱文件中，确认信息与所处理的确切源数据行绑定。

sents.en: Reading or queuing a message does not acknowledge it as processed.
sents.zh: 读取或排队一条消息并不意味着将其确认为已处理。

sents.en: A partially processed batch retains acknowledgments even when rows finish out of order, leaving unprocessed rows available for later delivery.
sents.zh: 部分处理的批次仍会保留确认信息，即使各行处理顺序不同，未处理的行仍可供后续投递使用。

sents.en: Capacity-deferred delegations retain their original identities and arguments when reconsidered for execution.
sents.zh: 因容量不足而延迟的委派在重新考虑执行时，会保留其原始标识和参数。

paragraphs.en: Workspace recovery follows the checked-update boundary shown in Figure 10 (b) and described in Section A.5 . The runtime saves the preceding workspace state and journals an update before committing changes. An interruption before commit leaves the persistent workspace unchanged; an interruption during commit can be recovered by restoring the saved files and classification metadata. The recovery is recorded explicitly. This mechanism applies to local workspace changes, not to reversing an email already sent or another external service action.
paragraphs.zh: 工作区恢复遵循图 10 (b) 所示并在 A.5 节中描述的已检查更新边界。 运行时在提交更改之前会保存先前的工作区状态并记录更新日志。 提交前的中断会使持久化工作区保持不变；提交期间发生的中断可以通过恢复已保存的文件和分类元数据来进行恢复。 恢复操作会被显式记录。 该机制适用于本地工作区更改，而不适用于撤回已发送的电子邮件或其他外部服务操作。

sents.en: Workspace recovery follows the checked-update boundary shown in Figure 10 (b) and described in Section A.5 .
sents.zh: 工作区恢复遵循图 10 (b) 所示并在 A.5 节中描述的已检查更新边界。

sents.en: The runtime saves the preceding workspace state and journals an update before committing changes.
sents.zh: 运行时在提交更改之前会保存先前的工作区状态并记录更新日志。

sents.en: An interruption before commit leaves the persistent workspace unchanged; an interruption during commit can be recovered by restoring the saved files and classification metadata.
sents.zh: 提交前的中断会使持久化工作区保持不变；提交期间发生的中断可以通过恢复已保存的文件和分类元数据来进行恢复。

sents.en: The recovery is recorded explicitly.
sents.zh: 恢复操作会被显式记录。

sents.en: This mechanism applies to local workspace changes, not to reversing an email already sent or another external service action.
sents.zh: 该机制适用于本地工作区更改，而不适用于撤回已发送的电子邮件或其他外部服务操作。

paragraphs.en: The runtime also monitors its action bridge and model-session service and supports replacing failed services. When the simulation process remains alive, active sessions can be reopened using saved conversation records and retained session metadata. This reconstructs context for subsequent turns rather than resuming an interrupted model generation internally. Transient connection failures receive bounded retries, and unsuccessful attempts remain recorded.
paragraphs.zh: 运行时还会监控其动作桥接和模型会话服务，并支持替换失败的服务。 当仿真进程仍存活时，可以使用已保存的对话记录和保留的会话元数据重新打开活跃的会话。 这会为后续轮次重建上下文，而不是在内部恢复被中断的模型生成。 瞬时连接失败会进行有界重试，未成功的尝试仍会被记录。

sents.en: The runtime also monitors its action bridge and model-session service and supports replacing failed services.
sents.zh: 运行时还会监控其动作桥接和模型会话服务，并支持替换失败的服务。

sents.en: When the simulation process remains alive, active sessions can be reopened using saved conversation records and retained session metadata.
sents.zh: 当仿真进程仍存活时，可以使用已保存的对话记录和保留的会话元数据重新打开活跃的会话。

sents.en: This reconstructs context for subsequent turns rather than resuming an interrupted model generation internally.
sents.zh: 这会为后续轮次重建上下文，而不是在内部恢复被中断的模型生成。

sents.en: Transient connection failures receive bounded retries, and unsuccessful attempts remain recorded.
sents.zh: 瞬时连接失败会进行有界重试，未成功的尝试仍会被记录。

paragraphs.en: Run-level monitoring can stop execution on detected violations or record them while allowing an endurance run to continue. The latter policy leaves operation-level authorization and validation checks in force. At shutdown, the runtime stops new activity, allows a bounded interval for ongoing work to settle, and reconciles assistant results with delivery records. Unfinished requests, failed attempts, and incomplete reviews remain in the saved state; reaching the target time does not mark them as finished.
paragraphs.zh: 运行级监控可以在检测到违规时停止执行，或在允许耐久运行继续的同时记录违规。 后一种策略会让操作级授权和验证检查继续生效。 在关机时，运行时会停止新活动，为进行中的工作留出有限的收尾时间，并将智能体的结果与投递记录进行对账。 未完成的请求、失败的尝试和未完成的审查仍保留在保存的状态中；到达目标时间并不会将它们标记为已完成。

sents.en: Run-level monitoring can stop execution on detected violations or record them while allowing an endurance run to continue.
sents.zh: 运行级监控可以在检测到违规时停止执行，或在允许耐久运行继续的同时记录违规。

sents.en: The latter policy leaves operation-level authorization and validation checks in force.
sents.zh: 后一种策略会让操作级授权和验证检查继续生效。

sents.en: At shutdown, the runtime stops new activity, allows a bounded interval for ongoing work to settle, and reconciles assistant results with delivery records.
sents.zh: 在关机时，运行时会停止新活动，为进行中的工作留出有限的收尾时间，并将智能体的结果与投递记录进行对账。

sents.en: Unfinished requests, failed attempts, and incomplete reviews remain in the saved state; reaching the target time does not mark them as finished.
sents.zh: 未完成的请求、失败的尝试和未完成的审查仍保留在保存的状态中；到达目标时间并不会将它们标记为已完成。

paragraphs.en: We examine material accumulation in the Juniper instance over 181 simulated days, from 1 January to 1 July 2026. These dates and all checkpoints in Figure 11 follow the simulation clock (Section A.6 ), not elapsed wall-clock time. Materials are counted at their first recorded simulated delivery, with repeated revisions counted once.
paragraphs.zh: 我们考察了 Juniper 实例在 181 个模拟日（从 2026 年 1 月 1 日至 7 月 1 日）中的素材累积情况。 这些日期以及图 11 中的所有检查点均遵循模拟时钟（A.6 节），而非实际流逝的真实时间。 素材按其首次记录的模拟交付进行统计，重复修订只计一次。

sents.en: We examine material accumulation in the Juniper instance over 181 simulated days, from 1 January to 1 July 2026.
sents.zh: 我们考察了 Juniper 实例在 181 个模拟日（从 2026 年 1 月 1 日至 7 月 1 日）中的素材累积情况。

sents.en: These dates and all checkpoints in Figure 11 follow the simulation clock (Section A.6 ), not elapsed wall-clock time.
sents.zh: 这些日期以及图 11 中的所有检查点均遵循模拟时钟（A.6 节），而非实际流逝的真实时间。

sents.en: Materials are counted at their first recorded simulated delivery, with repeated revisions counted once.
sents.zh: 素材按其首次记录的模拟交付进行统计，重复修订只计一次。

paragraphs.en: Figure 11 (a) shows the cumulative collection growing from 27 initial files to 209, 376, and 497 files by simulated days 60, 120, and 181, respectively. The additional materials span documents and notes, data files, workbooks, and other formats. Figure 11 (b) places these counts alongside selected materials available by each checkpoint: customer operating records, a scenario workbook, a retail-project source catalog, and a reusable workbook component. This observation describes material accumulation; it does not assess deliverable quality or task success.
paragraphs.zh: 图11 (a) 显示，资料收集量从最初的27个文件分别增长到模拟第60、120、181天的209、376和497个文件。 这些新增材料涵盖文档与笔记、数据文件、工作簿以及其他格式。 图11 (b) 将这些数量与各检查点时可用的精选材料并列展示：客户运营记录、一份场景工作簿、一个零售项目源目录以及一个可复用的工作簿组件。 该观察描述的是材料的积累，并不评估交付成果的质量或任务的成功与否。

sents.en: Figure 11 (a) shows the cumulative collection growing from 27 initial files to 209, 376, and 497 files by simulated days 60, 120, and 181, respectively.
sents.zh: 图11 (a) 显示，资料收集量从最初的27个文件分别增长到模拟第60、120、181天的209、376和497个文件。

sents.en: The additional materials span documents and notes, data files, workbooks, and other formats.
sents.zh: 这些新增材料涵盖文档与笔记、数据文件、工作簿以及其他格式。

sents.en: Figure 11 (b) places these counts alongside selected materials available by each checkpoint: customer operating records, a scenario workbook, a retail-project source catalog, and a reusable workbook component.
sents.zh: 图11 (b) 将这些数量与各检查点时可用的精选材料并列展示：客户运营记录、一份场景工作簿、一个零售项目源目录以及一个可复用的工作簿组件。

sents.en: This observation describes material accumulation; it does not assess deliverable quality or task success.
sents.zh: 该观察描述的是材料的积累，并不评估交付成果的质量或任务的成功与否。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 , Table 4 , and Tables 6 – 7 describe the same 406 benchmark tasks. Benchmark tasks, SFT demonstrations, and OPD environments have separate membership records; training-resource construction is described in Appendix E .
paragraphs.zh: 图4、表4以及表6–7描述的是同样的406个基准任务。 基准任务、SFT演示数据和OPD环境各自拥有独立的成员记录；训练资源的构建在附录E中描述。

sents.en: Figure 4 , Table 4 , and Tables 6 – 7 describe the same 406 benchmark tasks.
sents.zh: 图4、表4以及表6–7描述的是同样的406个基准任务。

sents.en: Benchmark tasks, SFT demonstrations, and OPD environments have separate membership records; training-resource construction is described in Appendix E .

paragraphs.en: Table 4 counts source organizations by their recorded organization identities, counting repeated simulations of the same identity once. Professional roles are distinct job titles of the primary delegating professionals, with case and whitespace normalized; they are not personnel counts or standardized occupational categories.
paragraphs.zh: 表4按所记录的组织身份统计来源机构数量，同一身份的重复模拟仅计一次。 专业角色是主要委托专业人员的不同职称，已对大小写和空格进行规范化处理；它们不是人员数量，也不是标准化的职业类别。

sents.en: Table 4 counts source organizations by their recorded organization identities, counting repeated simulations of the same identity once.

paragraphs.en: To ground tasks and evaluation criteria in professional practice, we engaged 71 domain experts across eight professional domains during benchmark construction. Task-specific expertise requirements covered relevant specialization and occupational background, the ability to make independent professional judgments, and familiarity with native working materials and applicable standards. The construction-stage annotation records cover 1,051 candidate tasks and 32,274 rubric criteria. Among 1,011 recorded task-level familiarity assessments, 98.9% indicated that reviewers were familiar or very familiar with the assigned work. Experts assessed task realism and feasibility and examined rubric correctness, coverage, and importance, providing 3,842 criterion-level recommendations to edit, remove, merge, or split criteria. The annotations subsequently underwent a separate review pass, combining expert assessment with follow-up quality control and producing refinement feedback traceable to individual tasks and criteria.
paragraphs.zh: 为了使任务和评估标准扎根于专业实践，我们在基准构建过程中邀请了来自八个专业领域的 71 位领域专家。 任务特定的专业能力要求涵盖相关专长方向和职业背景、能够做出独立专业判断，以及熟悉原生的日常工作材料和适用标准。 构建阶段的标注记录涵盖 1,051 个候选任务和 32,274 条评分标准。 在 1,011 条有记录的任务级熟悉度评估中，98.9% 表示评审者对所分配的工作熟悉或非常熟悉。 专家评估任务的真实性和可行性，并审查评分标准的正确性、覆盖面和重要性，共提出了 3,842 条针对编辑、删除、合并或拆分标准的条目级建议。 这些标注随后经过了一轮独立的审查，将专家评估与后续质量控制相结合，产出了可追溯到单个任务和评分标准的改进反馈。

paragraphs.en: In the Riverbend case, a Reconciliation Operations Manager requests Excel workpapers for three exception streams: customer deposits, card clearing, and vendor credits. The agent receives an input brief, an operating-data packet, a native workbook, and a triage memo. It must reconcile the available records, explain unresolved differences, and identify the evidence needed before an adjustment or period-close conclusion can be supported.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Riverbend 案例中，一位对账运营经理要求提供三个异常数据流的 Excel 工作底稿：客户存款、卡清算和供应商贷记。 智能体收到一份输入简报、一份数据包、一个原生工作簿和一份分类备忘录。 智能体必须核对可用记录，解释未解决的差异，并识别在支持调整或期末结账结论之前所需的证据。

paragraphs.en: The card-clearing entry in Figure 13 (a) contains a $42.50 difference; the memo identifies missing settlement records and fee details needed to investigate it. The requested workpapers must reconcile the three listed differences to $1,117.50, cite the supporting records, and keep unsupported conclusions open. A balanced total alone does not establish that an exception is resolved.

paragraphs.en: The curves use recorded final grades and execution-ending turns. At budget T T , an outcome contributes its final score if execution has ended within T T turns, and zero otherwise, with a fixed denominator. This includes graded partial outcomes from executions without a final answer. Nonnegative score accumulation makes the curves monotone; it neither scores intermediate artifacts nor reruns tasks under shorter stopping budgets. The figures display five fixed budgets (8, 16, 24, 32, and 48 turns), with connecting lines as visual guides; exact threshold crossings use the full records.
paragraphs.zh: 这些曲线使用记录的最终成绩和执行结束时的轮次。 在预算 T T 下，如果执行在 T T 轮内结束，则该结果计入其最终分数，否则计为零，并使用固定分母。 这包括来自没有最终答案的执行的已评分部分结果。 非负分数的累加使这些曲线单调；它既不对中间产物评分，也不会在更短的停止预算下重新运行任务。 图中显示了五个固定预算（8、16、24、32 和 48 轮），连接线仅作视觉引导；精确的阈值交叉点使用完整记录计算。

paragraphs.en: The SFT resource contains 2,202 complete trajectories distilled from DeepSeek-V4-Flash ( Xu et al., 2026a ) . From 2,317 trajectories in the original SFT partition, we exclude 46 tool-serialization cases, 62 exceeding context capacity and seven parser round-trip cases, leaving 2,202. Trajectories are neither truncated nor filtered by task-success score. The resource is split into 1,982 training and 220 validation demonstrations. Two training and four validation padding rows contain no supervised tokens and are not counted as additional demonstrations.
paragraphs.zh: SFT 资源包含从 DeepSeek-V4-Flash（Xu et al., 2026a）蒸馏得到的 2,202 条完整轨迹。 从原始 SFT 分区中的 2,317 条轨迹里，我们排除了 46 个工具序列化案例、62 个超出上下文容量的案例以及 7 个解析器往返案例，剩余 2,202 条。 轨迹既未被截断，也未按任务成功分数进行过滤。 该资源被划分为 1,982 条训练演示和 220 条验证演示。 两行训练数据和四行验证数据是填充行，不包含任何监督标记，因此不计入额外的演示。

paragraphs.en: SFT updates all parameters of Qwen3.5-9B for two epochs using AdamW, with a 14-step warmup followed by linear learning-rate decay. paragraphs.en: Figures 18 – 20 plot five fixed turn budgets per benchmark; endpoints match Table 3 . They summarize existing executions rather than reruns stopped at each budget. Lines guide the eye between recorded points. Each execution contributes zero before its recorded ending turn and its final score thereafter, using a fixed denominator; intermediate artifacts are not rescored. JobBench keeps the original partial grade when a run stops at the response-token limit and follows the benchmark’s rules for missing grades. Turn counts are not directly comparable as inference cost.
paragraphs.zh: 图18至图20针对每个基准绘制了五个固定的轮次预算；端点与表3一致。 它们汇总的是已有的执行结果，而不是在各个预算处停止的重跑。 曲线仅用于在已记录的数据点之间引导视线。 在其记录的结束轮次之前，每次执行贡献为零，此后贡献其最终得分，并使用固定分母；中间产物不会被重新评分。 当运行在响应token限制处停止时，JobBench保留原有的部分评分，并遵循该基准对缺失评分的规则。 轮次数量不能直接作为推理成本进行比较。
